summary: Frontend-only verification of Google Analytics tags (G-F48RFBBEP7 + GT-NSSVHXXP), Consent Mode v2, SPA page_view emission, and the two Services popup fixes. Nearly everything passes. One regression found: the /contact page reports the PREVIOUS page's title in the GA page_view because Contact.js does not render <SEOHead>, so document.title never updates on that route.

ui_bugs.issue: Contact page imports SEOHead but never renders it. document.title stays as the previously-visited page's title. Consequently the GA page_view for /contact carries the wrong page_title (e.g. 'Blog — Orgainse Consulting …' when navigating Blog -> Contact). Titles WILL lag one page behind on /contact, which the review request explicitly forbids.

action_items: Add a <SEOHead title=... description=... /> render to /app/frontend/src/pages/Contact.js (import is already present) so that client-side navigation to /contact updates document.title before the RouteAnalytics 400ms timer fires. All other pages (Home, About, Services, Products, BlogIndex, NewsletterIndex, PrivacyPolicy, TermsOfService) already do this correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: RouteAnalytics correctly delays 400ms before firing page_view, but this only works if the destination page mounts SEOHead synchronously in the first render. Contact.js is the only page missing that call — see action item.

index.html uses a single gtag.js loader for G-F48RFBBEP7 (correct — GT-NSSVHXXP is a Google Tag destination configured through the same loader, exactly as the request states). Consent Mode v2 default is set BEFORE gtag('js'), reading localStorage.orgainse_consent — behaviour verified.
CookieBanner useEffect writes localStorage and calls gtag('consent','update', …) only after the user clicks accept/reject — correct.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PASSED items — do not re-test unless something in App.js / index.html / CookieBanner.js / ServicePopup.js changes: (1) gtag loader for G-F48RFBBEP7 present in index.html; window.gtag is a function; performance resources contain www.googletagmanager.com/gtag/js?id=G-F48RFBBEP7. (2) dataLayer on fresh session contains ['consent','default',{ad_storage:denied, ad_user_data:denied, ad_personalization:denied, analytics_storage:denied, functionality_storage:granted, security_storage:granted}] followed by ['js',<date>], ['config','G-F48RFBBEP7'], ['config','GT-NSSVHXXP']. (3) Clicking cookie-accept-btn pushes ['consent','update',{analytics_storage:'granted'}], stores localStorage 'orgainse_consent'='accepted', banner dismisses; reload then shows consent default with analytics_storage:'granted'. (4) Clicking cookie-reject-btn pushes ['consent','update',{analytics_storage:'denied'}] and dismisses banner. (5) SPA page_view fires for /services, /products, /about, /blog, /contact with correct page_path (verified via window.dataLayer). (6) ServicePopup — Escape / X-button / backdrop click all close the modal, and body scroll is restored. (7) Healthcare Revenue Intelligence popup (6th Learn More card, service.id='healthcare-revenue-intelligence') renders data-testid=service-not-included-healthcare-revenue-intelligence AND service-who-we-serve-healthcare-revenue-intelligence AND the pre-existing service-right-fit-* / service-not-right-fit-* blocks. The OTHER five popups do NOT render empty notIncluded / whoWeServe blocks (the conditional guard is working). (8) Zero React / console / pageerror on /, /about, /services, /products, /blog, /newsletter, /contact, /privacy, /terms and a bogus 404 route (the 4 'Failed to load resource 404' entries relate to preload/social favicons and are pre-existing, not from this round's changes). ONLY OPEN ITEM: Contact page title lag (see frontend_issues.ui_bugs).
rca of the issue: Contact.js imports SEOHead but never renders <SEOHead />. Because Orgainse is a SPA, document.title is only mutated via SEOHead's react-helmet call on route mount. When the user client-navigates FROM any page WITH a title (e.g. /blog with 'Blog — Orgainse …') TO /contact, no component updates document.title on /contact, so RouteAnalytics's setTimeout(400ms) reads the STALE title from the previous route and pushes it as page_title in the GA page_view. Reproduction: navigate Blog -> Contact, wait ≥2.5s, evaluate document.title — it still equals the Blog title. Fix: add <SEOHead title='Contact Orgainse Consulting | …' description='…' /> at the top of Contact.js's returned JSX (import is already present at line 21). All other pages set SEOHead and their page_view titles verified as correct on this run.
